proposed_changes.suggested_wording: Build independent practice that requires the target learner operation before feedback. Preserve explicit product requirements: easy, moderate and hard capability; source provenance and eligibility; learner-state preservation; publication through the runner; and genuine mathematical, grading and rendering checks. Treat source-template assumptions, earlier agent conclusions and examples as revisable interpretations. When an interpretation conflicts with the learner operation, correct it, state the evidence and retain a regression for the intended behavior. A demonstrated conflict with an explicit product requirement must remain an explicit unresolved decision; do not silently waive it. The current role contract and this principles document govern the workflow; numbered guides are implementation references and historical run notes are evidence only.
proposed_changes.rationale: Keeps authorized judgment and all valid constraints while preventing “override” from becoming either meaningless under a forest of musts or permission to ignore product requirements. Resolve conflicting guide sentences in the same change; hierarchy alone is not enough.

proposed_changes.action: replace duplicated normative rules with two explicit modes

locations.claim: Map observed banks as evidence rather than mandatory runtime recipes.

proposed_changes.suggested_wording: Keep two claims separate. Source replay reconstructs every usable, eligible complete source case at its original parameters, preserving its full bank as evidence and documenting source defects. Served practice derives a valid bank from the learner operation and the sampled instance. Reuse an observed bank recipe only while it remains mathematically valid, plausible and free of demonstrated incidental answer cues over its intended domain. Otherwise author or repair the bank, record its relationship to the source, and retain the original replay separately. A source bank defect or unavailable component does not by itself exclude the valid mathematical family. Do not claim an authored replacement is exact source replay; do not publish source defects to satisfy fidelity.
proposed_changes.rationale: Directly breaks the source-template-to-answer-role mechanism without discarding source fidelity, complete banks, or plausible distractors. Remove the contradictory normal-generation instructions rather than adding another exception paragraph.

Record what changes, keep incidental work manageable, and distinguish authored calibration from observed imported labels.
proposed_changes.rationale: Preserves three bands and meaningful progression while removing the specific extra-work mandate. The existing matched-instance comparison remains useful evidence, not a demand to invent extra stages.

proposed_changes.suggested_wording: For independent practice, do not supply a decision, setup, intermediate result or formula recall that the target task requires the learner to produce. Source support is evidence only for that source’s objective and stage; support in a worked solution or another KP does not transfer automatically. If target evidence is incomplete, state the intended operation and prerequisite recall first. Add only givens needed to define the task, or a non-target fact whose supply demonstrably leaves that operation and recall intact; justify this explicitly. If the fact is an assessed prerequisite or introduces an unrelated new method, choose a simpler instance instead. Keep genuinely guided teaching activities distinct.
proposed_changes.rationale: Retains the newly fixed anti-giveaway rule. It does not license formula hints merely because easy evidence is missing; it resolves conflicts for a task-defining given or non-target fact.

proposed_changes.action: replace categorical small-sample failure wording with bounded mechanism criterion
proposed_changes.suggested_wording: A batch defect needs a learner-observable rule that bypasses the intended operation and a reproducible construction or selection mechanism. Define the rule and its allowed information before the confirming test. For a rule discovered in a small subgroup, seek an independent controlled or fresh-batch confirmation and report the subgroup size and baseline. A demonstrable structural giveaway in the delivered batch remains a defect even when broader samples contain counterexamples. A post-hoc perfect score on two or five records alone is not proof of a recurring defect and does not justify forcing answer balance. Record an inconclusive concern as such; repair confirmed mechanisms across applicable batches rather than selecting a favorable seed.
proposed_changes.rationale: Keeps finite-pool protection, before/after checks and deterministic general repair. Avoids reintroducing arbitrary quotas through a universal “every member” test.

proposed_changes.suggested_wording: For substitution families, exercise supported endpoint and function cases when their differences are part of the target work. Do not impose sign, endpoint-count or answer-balance quotas. A zero contribution, cancellation or fixed result is valid when it expresses the intended skill; reject it only when an incidental family cue removes that skill. For equilibrium questions whose intended method is testing constant candidates after rearrangement, retain a consistent residual and domain and avoid gratuitous expansion or repeated work. Preserve a different source-supported method when it serves the same objective and workload.
